create_model_vggt: create a VGGT model instance with configurable camera, point, depth, and track heads
run_forward_inference: run the VGGT forward pass on a sequence of images to predict camera poses, depth, and 3D points
predict_camera_poses: predict camera pose encodings from a sequence of input images using the VGGT camera head
predict_depth_maps: predict per-pixel depth maps and confidence scores from input images using the VGGT depth head
track_query_points: track query points across a sequence of images and return visibility and confidence scores
